title: Getting around and commuting
situation: Finding your way, getting to work by tram, metro, bus or train, and buying tickets.

canDo.text: You can ask where something is and understand simple directions.
You can say where you're going and how you get to work.
You can say where you are and where things are.
You can buy a ticket and ask when a train or bus leaves.

missions.title: Ask the way
missions.task: On a tram or at a stop, ask someone in Czech whether it goes where you're going, or where to get off.

phrases.en: Excuse me, does this go to Anděl?

missions.ifStuck: Nerozumím. Můžete mluvit pomaleji? (I don't understand. Could you speak more slowly?)

exercises.prompt: Excuse me, where is the pharmacy?

hints.explain: To a stranger, use the formal Promiňte.

answers: {Go|Walk|Keep going} straight[ on| ahead] and then[ turn| go] right[.]
exercises.why: rovně = straight on, pak = then, doprava = (to the) right.

hints.wrong: {Go|Walk|Keep going} straight[ on| ahead] and then[ turn| go] left[.]
hints.explain: doprava is right; doleva is left.
do takes the genitive: do kina.

exercises.why: Means of transport take the instrumental: vlak → vlakem.

hints.explain: vlaku is the dative/locative. "By train" is the instrumental: vlakem.
After v (in), use the locative: v Praze.

exercises.why: Location (where?) takes the locative: na poště.

hints.explain: na poštu is for movement (Jdu na poštu). Location takes the locative: na poště.
After na (where?), use the locative: na poště.

exercises.prompt: One return ticket to Brno, please.
answers: {Jednu zpáteční jízdenku|Jeden zpáteční lístek} do Brna[, prosím].
exercises.why: Use the accusative for the ticket (jednu zpáteční jízdenku) and do + genitive (do Brna).

hints.wrong: Jedna zpáteční jízdenka do Brna[, prosím].
hints.explain: Use the accusative: jednu zpáteční jízdenku.

answers: The train {leaves|departs} at {half past eight|eight thirty|8:30|8.30|half eight}[.]
exercises.why: půl deváté = half (of the way to) nine = 8:30.

hints.wrong: The train {leaves|departs} at {half past nine|nine thirty|9:30|9.30|half nine}[.]
hints.explain: půl deváté means half way to nine: 8:30.
